name: Epinephrine
overview: A long and sustained outing with plenty of chimney work, so you want to be comfortable at the grade. Expect extended easy scrambling to get down. Pitches can be combined to save time, particularly higher up past the tower top.
descent: two-rope rappels via the roof-lip belay, then a second rappel and some downclimbing
fa: Jorge Urioste, Joanne Urioste, Joe Herbst, 1978
